name: smith reverse-grip press
description: A press with an underhand grip on the smith bar, lowering to the chest and pressing back up. It trains the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar and lie back with your feet planted.
Take an underhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and keep your wrists aligned with your forearms.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows comfortably close to your sides.
Press the bar back up without bouncing it off your chest, then secure it on the hooks.
